name: Shadowburg
source:
In need of a change of scenery, Zeb Lee decides to follow his cousin Molly’s advice and moves to Shadowburg, PA. Hoping that the sleepy little town will help him jumpstart his creativity, he soon discovers that neither the town nor its inhabitants are what they seem...

[From [url=https://poorlyformed.itch.io/shadowburg]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于需要换换环境，泽布·李决定听从表弟莫莉的建议，搬到宾夕法尼亚州的影子堡。他希望这个沉睡的小镇能帮助他激发他的创造力，但他很快发现这座小镇和它的居民都不是他们看上去的那样……

[来自[url=https://poorlyformed.itch.io/shadowburg]itch.io[/url]]
